categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a professional DMS (Design & Manufacturing Service) provider specializing in Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) and photovoltaic (PV) inverters. Its product portfolio includes Off-Line UPS (400VA–3000VA), On-Line UPS (1KVA–1.4MVA), and Inverter/PV Inverter products (600VA–50KVA), along with accessories such as SNMP cards and PDU switches. The company focuses on customized design and manufacturing services for global brand customers without developing its own brand.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced digital signal processors (DSP) and microcontrollers (MCU) for UPS system digital control and monitoring, enhancing reliability and efficiency. It develops high power density UPS modules, high-efficiency off-line and on-line UPS models, and integrates lithium battery systems. For PV inverters, it focuses on high conversion efficiency, modular design, bidirectional inverters, and integration with energy storage and smart grid technologies. Production emphasizes vertical integration, automation, and flexible manufacturing to support small-lot, highly customized orders.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 500 customers globally, primarily international brand clients in the UPS and PV inverter sectors. End markets include data centers, telecommunications, industrial automation, medical equipment, consumer electronics, public infrastructure, and renewable energy sectors. Its products are mainly sold for use in server rooms, cloud computing facilities, smart grids, and solar power installations, with over 90% of sales being exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major sales markets in Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Its manufacturing bases are primarily located in China and Vietnam, with corporate headquarters and R&D in Taiwan. Sales distribution shows over 97% export ratio, with significant revenue from Asian markets (over 53%) and the rest from other global regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company occupies a midstream position in the supply chain as an ODM/OEM manufacturer providing design and manufacturing services. It procures key components such as batteries, transformers, semiconductors, and PCBs from multiple suppliers and delivers finished products to brand customers who then sell to downstream end users across various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in UPS and PV inverter technologies, focusing on energy efficiency, modularization, digital control, and integration with renewable energy and smart grid systems. R&D efforts target development of high power density UPS modules, lithium battery systems, hybrid inverters, and advanced monitoring software including apps for remote control and maintenance. The company also emphasizes environmental sustainability and compliance with international standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of customized UPS systems, PV inverters, and related accessories under a DMS business model. The company does not sell products under its own brand but provides design and manufacturing services to brand customers worldwide. Revenue growth is driven by expanding customer base, new product introductions, and increasing demand in data center and renewable energy markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the largest global DMS manufacturers in the UPS and PV inverter industries, competing with over 100 global UPS manufacturers and numerous PV inverter producers. It differentiates by focusing exclusively on ODM services without brand competition, leveraging strong R&D capabilities, vertical integration, and flexible production. It holds a significant market share in the midstream manufacturing segment and maintains long-term partnerships with leading international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$22.8 billion, a 20.4% increase year-over-year, and a net profit after tax of NT$4.2 billion, up 16.1%. Earnings per share grew by 15.9% to NT$48.13. The company maintains steady growth with expanding R&D investment (~4.2% of revenue) and a workforce of nearly 3,000 employees. Financials reflect strong operational performance and stable cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and customized power protection and renewable energy products tailored to customer specifications. Its DMS model avoids brand conflicts, fostering trust and long-term partnerships. Competitive advantages include comprehensive product lines from small to large capacity UPS and PV inverters, rapid product development cycles, advanced digital control technologies, vertical integration for cost control, and adherence to international environmental and quality standards.
